description: Java source code for SelfLoanProductsApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving self loan product information in the Fineract project.

classes.name: SelfLoanProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for self loan products, providing endpoints to retrieve all loan products and specific loan product details.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all loan products accessible to a client, validating client mapping before delegating to LoanProductsApiResource.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific loan product by ID, validating client mapping before delegating to LoanProductsApiResource.
